title: Reflected mssql table with NUMERIC() IDENTITY column errors on Core insert()

labels.name: reflection
labels.description: reflection of tables, columns, constraints, defaults, sequences, views, everything else

labels.name: datatypes
labels.description: things to do with database types, like VARCHAR and others

body:
### Describe the bug

A reflected mssql table with a NUMERIC(18, 0) IDENTITY column throws an error when we try to use Core insert() on it.

### To Reproduce

```python
import sqlalchemy as sa

connection_url = (
    "mssql+pyodbc://scott:tiger^5HHH@192.168.0.199/test"
    "?driver=ODBC+Driver+17+for+SQL+Server"
)
engine = sa.create_engine(connection_url)

table_name = "numeric_identity"

with engine.begin() as conn:
    conn.exec_driver_sql(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {table_name}")
    conn.exec_driver_sql(
        f"CREATE TABLE {table_name} (id numeric(18, 0) identity primary key, txt varchar(50))"
    )
    conn.exec_driver_sql(f"INSERT INTO {table_name} (txt) VALUES ('raw sql')")

with engine.begin() as cn:
    print(cn.exec_driver_sql(f"SELECT * FROM {table_name}").all())
    # [(Decimal('1'), 'raw sql')]

tbl = sa.Table(table_name, sa.MetaData(), autoload_with=engine)

with engine.begin() as conn:
    conn.execute(tbl.insert(), dict(txt="core insert"))
    # sqlalchemy.exc.ArgumentError: Column type NUMERIC(18, 0) on column 'numeric_identity.id' is not compatible with autoincrement=True
```
